text:
Maya: Nightly eval flagged 14 failures on q4 models. Looks like most are function-call parse errors when model emits multi-line JSON in `args` field.
Samir: ugh, example?
Maya: here's one (copied from logs):
```
{"tool":"annotate","args":{
  "text":"Line1
Line2",
  "meta":{...}
}}
```
Maya: the harness `json.loads` gets a SyntaxError because the model returns a literal unescaped newline inside the string. Some outputs use `\n` and others an actual newline.
Julia: Is that only on the q4 quantized variant?
Maya: Mostly q4 variants + a q5 candidate. FP16 baseline ok.
Denise: Could be tokenizer detokenization differences or our postproc failing to escape strings. Also saw CRLF sequences (`\r\n`) in a subset.
Samir: eval-bot, can you dump raw sequences for a failing sample?
eval-bot: nightly-run 1980012300: id=run-492, model=redwood-q4f, file=eval/funccalls/recipe-12.log, stderr attached.
Maya: I pushed a quick repro in /tmp/fnparse_repro.txt — basically `model_response['content']` contains unescaped newlines before we call `json.loads`.
Samir: short-term fix: wrap with a sanitizer that replaces literal newline inside quotes with `\n` using a heuristics regex before parse. Long-term: update eval harness to require models to emit `json.dumps` style strings or call `function_call` API directly.
Julia: Can we add a nightly check to flag inconsistent newline encodings (actual \n vs escaped) across runs?
Denise: yes, added a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-2319
Maya: I'll attach a small patch and a failing sample. cc @Samir @Julia
Samir: I'll take ownership of a short term patch. If it helps, add test cases with CRLF and bare LF.
Maya: TY, will follow up with repro snippets.
